api.note: Only the public address of the media proxy goes here. The Bible Brain key stays on the server.

bibleBrain.note: Countries, languages and versions are listed in offline-text.json. The build writes text/catalog.json, which the game reads. If the media server is used, each version's fileset must be in ALLOWED_FILESETS.

staticAudio.note: Set enabled to true only after the audio has been downloaded at build time and the licence allows it.

staticText.note: Text is read from files published at build time (DOWNLOAD_TEXT=true). Set to false to use the media server instead.

features.note: Audio and video games are coming soon. Set to true once audio or video content is connected.
